title: French Delight Date Tart
description: A sweet French tart filled with caramelized medjool dates and topped with a delight of powdered sugar. Perfect for a dessert or snack.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry and place on a baking sheet.
In a pan, caramelize the medjool dates with sugar and butter.
Roll out the puff pastry to fit the baking sheet.
Spread the caramelized dates on the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border.
Fold the edges of the pastry up to form a crust.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and vanilla extract.
Brush the egg mixture over the pastry.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
